description: Implement Export Gate + Package Finalization (Task 5.9). Pre-export validation checks, export formats (plain text, markdown), and the /api/packages/[id]/export endpoint that returns blocking issues as structured list if validation fails.
steps: Create src/lib/packages/export.ts with exportPackage(packageId, format) function that: (1) loads the package with all generations and their spans, (2) runs pre-export checks: all model-supplied spans have disposition (accepted/rejected, not pending), no unverified spans remain without explicit acceptance, freshness check on all external claims within their window, confidentiality check on flagged claims being dispositioned, format validation (word count within limits, no markdown artifacts, no smart quotes), (3) if all checks pass returns the formatted document, (4) if any check fails returns structured blocking issues list with resolution instructions.

Implement the freshness check: for each claim used in the package's generations, find its ClaimArtifact records, check if any have freshnessWindow set and ingestionDate + freshnessWindow < now(). If expired, add to blocking issues.

Implement the confidentiality check: for each span's claim, check if the claim has artifacts from SourceDocuments with currentEmployer=true or confidential=true. If such claims haven't been explicitly dispositioned, add to blocking issues.

Implement format validation: word count per document type (cover-letter: 250-300, resume: no hard limit, essay: flexible), scan for markdown artifacts (**, ***, ##, ```), scan for smart quotes (unicode curly quotes).
Implement plain text export: concatenate all rendered text from generations in the package, strip any residual formatting.
Implement markdown export: format with proper headings per document type, maintain structure.

Create src/app/api/packages/[id]/export/route.ts: POST endpoint accepting { format: 'text' | 'markdown' }. Runs the export gate, returns either { success: true, content, format } or { success: false, blockingIssues: Array<{ check, detail, resolution }> }.

Write tests in src/lib/__tests__/export-gate.test.ts covering: export blocked when model-supplied span has no disposition, export blocked when external claim is past freshness window, export blocked when confidential claim is undispositioned, plain text has no markdown artifacts, word count validated, blocking issues returned as structured list.
acceptance_criteria: Export blocked if any model-supplied span has disposition='pending' or null
Export blocked if any external claim is past freshness window
Export blocked if any confidential/currentEmployer claim is undispositioned
Plain text export has no markdown artifacts
Word count is validated against document-type limit before export
Blocking issues returned as structured list with check name, detail, and resolution instructions
POST /api/packages/[id]/export returns formatted document on success
Tests pass for all export gate scenarios
findings: Used \s\S instead of /s flag for dotAll regex (TypeScript target does not support es2018 regex flags). Removed unused PackageWithGenerations interface to satisfy ESLint. All 228 tests pass (17 new export-gate tests). Build and lint clean.
